subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde
description: A quick, practical guide to Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde.

hook.text: Stevenson wrote Jekyll and Hyde after a nightmare in 1885. His wife heard him screaming.

buildup.text: Dr. Jekyll creates a potion that releases his dark side as a separate person: Mr. Hyde.

discovery.text: The story is Jung's Shadow theory in fiction. Splitting good from evil makes both uncontrollable.

twist.text: Hyde grows stronger with each appearance. Repression doesn't weaken the Shadow; it feeds it.

climax.text: Jekyll can't return to himself. The lesson: you can't divide yourself without losing both halves.

quiz.question: What happens to Hyde as the story progresses?
